summary: Created a pip-installable `src`-layout `autofdtd` package scaffold with subsystem namespaces, development tooling, a code-backed Phase 1 feature matrix, tests, and MkDocs documentation aligned to the Phase 1 feature checklist and solver subsystem boundaries.
key_findings: The repository now has a buildable/editable package scaffold using `hatchling` in `pyproject.toml` with test, lint, type-check, and docs entrypoints.
Phase 1 feature-planning is encoded in `src/autofdtd/planning.py`, giving later tasks a local typed source for feature status and reserved namespace boundaries instead of relying only on markdown.

Subsystem namespaces are reserved up front for `api`, `core`, `geometry`, `materials`, `boundaries`, `sources`, `monitors`, `grid`, `modes`, `ir`, `compiler`, `runtime`, `kernels`, `diagnostics`, and `examples`.
A concrete install smoke target now exists via the `autofdtd-feature-matrix` CLI, which renders the packaged Phase 1 feature matrix in table or JSON form.
Validation passed for editable install, package imports, CLI tests, `pytest`, `ruff`, `mypy`, and `mkdocs build`.

artifacts.description: Packaging and development tooling configuration for editable installs, tests, linting, typing, and docs.
Typed Phase 1 feature matrix and namespace plan anchored to the local Tidy3D-inspired checklist.
CLI entrypoint exposing the packaged feature matrix for smoke testing and inspection.
Top-level package exports for versioning and planning metadata.
Reserved `src`-layout package namespaces for API, IR, compiler, runtime, kernels, diagnostics, and feature families.
MkDocs configuration for the new documentation scaffold.
Documentation scaffold covering overview, architecture, feature matrix, and development entrypoints.
Import, planning, and CLI smoke tests validating the scaffold.
Repository README expanded to describe package layout, quick start, and development commands.
Condensed Phase 1 handoff notes recording scaffold decisions for later tasks.

follow_up_notes: Next logical work is `task-002`: populate `autofdtd.api` and `autofdtd.core` with the tagged immutable `Simulation`, `Scene`, and `Structure` models while preserving the reserved subsystem layout established here.
